mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, c1.C_Name as tcBuildName, c2.C_Name as tcDesignName, c3.C_Name as tcConstructionName, mn.* from Technical_Check mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Tc_Build_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Tc_Design_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=mn.Tc_Construction_Id where mn.id = #{id}
